chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from al-Nawfalī, from al-Sukūnī, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
He was asked, “Why is it that the dead person emits semen?” He said, “He casts out the drop from which he was created.”

key_terms.النُّطْفَةُ: the seminal drop from which human creation begins

ai.seo_question: Why does a dead person emit semen according to the hadith of Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith describes a physical occurrence associated with the dead body and attributes it to the expulsion of the drop from which the person was created. It presents a concise explanation transmitted from Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام concerning a matter observed at death.
